description: Instrument sensitivity audit for all X_i potential-scaling discriminating tests; CF4 two-intercept mixture correction.

cf4_mixture.interpretation: With canonical TEP-H0 sigma_inferred for R22 hosts, both the single-intercept slope (-3.99e5 mag) and the two-intercept hierarchical slope (-5.69e5 mag, offset +0.145 +- 0.051 mag at 2.87sigma) recover the TEP-predicted negative sign, with corr(X_i, R22)=0.04.

cf4_pooled_single_intercept.note: With canonical TEP-H0 sigma_inferred for R22 hosts, the pooled single-intercept slope is negative (-3.99e+05 +- 7.52e+05 mag, TEP sign), and X_i is uncorrelated with the R22 flag (r=0.04).

cf4_two_intercept.note: Per-reduction intercepts: slope -5.69e+05 +- 6.87e+05 (TEP-predicted negative sign), alpha_R22 = +0.145 +- 0.063 mag (r=0.04). Consistent with the TEP prediction at |d|/sigma = 0.95.

teph0_raw_primary.note: Unregistered SH0ES Cepheid + EDD/CCHP TRGB, N=18.

jwst_r22_combination.note: JWST NIRCam TRGB x R22 Cepheid (N=17): slope -3.36e+05 +- 6.03e+05 mag (TEP-predicted negative sign; filter-corrected -5.10e+05 +- 6.21e+05 mag, weighted mean Delta_mu = -0.0420 +- 0.0237 mag, 1.77sigma).

jwst_mf2023_vih_same_team.note: Same-team MF2023 VIH Cepheid x JWST TRGB, N=13: 13/13 negative (p=0.00012, 3.67sigma one-sided sign test; weighted mean -0.196 +- 0.016 mag, Pearson r = -0.205 negative TEP sign).

band_mf2023_vih_minus_vi.note: Predicted band-differential slope -1.87e+05 vs instrument sigma 5.45e+05 — non-discriminating by construction (sensitivity 0.34 sigma). M101 Cook's D = 0.6; exclusion flips to -1.62e+06 (correct sign).
band_mf2023_vih_minus_vi.robust_estimator_note: Converged Student-t (nu=4) slope is negative (TEP sign) — the WLS positive slope is the M101 leverage draw; prior pipeline runs reported an unconverged optimizer echo (slope == WLS start, err ~ 1.0) that was fixed by parameter rescaling in step_49.

band_key_project_cross_team.note: Key Project optical vs R22 NIR, N=9.

sn_xi_step_measured_vrot.note: N=134 measured-V_rot hosts (N_high=105, N_low=29): weighted step +108.1 +- 39.0 mmag (+2.77sigma); OLS step +121.2 +- 48.1 mmag (+2.52sigma); mass-residualized step +125.1 +- 47.8 mmag (+2.62sigma).

verdict: All 10 potential-scaling and X_i-step tests in the ledger recover the TEP-predicted sign (10/10 favorable direction, 0 adverse, 0 mixture artifacts), including the 3.68sigma same-team MF2023 band differential, the 3.67sigma (13/13) MF2023 VIH x JWST TRGB sign test, and the 2.77sigma WLS (2.62sigma mass-residualized) measured-V_rot SN Ia X_i-step.
